items.title: 33.2 Pani ki aaloodgi ke zaraye (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sources of water pollution (PDF 249-250).

blocks.text: Aaloodgi ke zaraye chhote aur aik nuqte par ho sakte hain, ya bohat si jagahein jo aik jaisi ya mukhtalif aaloodgi daalti hain. Is bunyaad par pani ki aaloodgi ke zaraye do qismon mein taqseem hote hain.

blocks.title: Point-source aaloodgi
blocks.text: Point-source aaloodgi woh aaloodgi hai jo aik akeli, alag aur qabil-e-shanakht jagah ya nuqte se aabi zakhire mein dakhil ho.

Kyunke ikhraj aik nuqte par mutamarkiz hota hai, yeh aksar aaloodgi ka plume banata hai. Ikhraj ki jagah ke foran neeche aaloodgi (jaise heavy metals ya organic kachra) ka concentration sab se zyada hota, jis se maqami shadeed zehreelapan hota hai. Misalein: koi karkhana gande pani ke pipe se lead ya mercury salts seedha darya mein dale, aur kimiyai plant ka zakhira tank apna maddah mitti aur phir zameeni pani mein risaye. Kitab ki Figure 33.1 pipe se pani ki naali mein girte shehri sewage ki tasveer hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf karkhana (factory); us ka pipe aik hi jagah darya mein khulta hai, aur wahan se narangi aaloodgi ka plume darya ke bahao ke saath lamba ho kar phailta hai.
blocks.caption: Point source: aik pipe, aik jagah (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki Figure 33.1 tasveer hai).
blocks.long_description: Aaloodgi aik qabil-e-shanakht nuqte se aati hai, is liye pipe ke foran neeche concentration sab se zyada hota hai.

blocks.title: Non-point source (NPS) aaloodgi
blocks.text: Non-point source aaloodgi, jise phaili hui (diffuse) aaloodgi bhi kehte hain, tab hoti hai jab barish ya pighalti barf zameen ke oopar aur andar se guzar kar qudrati aur insani aaloodgi utha leti aur aakhir unhein jheelon, daryaon, daldali ilaqon aur sahili paniyon mein daal deti hai.

Point sources ke bar-aks NPS aaloodgi shadeed toofan jaise mausami waqiat par bohat munhasir hai. Yeh kaheen zyada wasee ilaqe mein kam concentrations par mukhtalif aaloodgiyon ka amezah deti hai. Misalein: barish hazaron hectare kheton se faltu ammonium nitrate (NH4NO3), khaad aur pesticides darya ke nizam mein baha le, aur toofani pani sarkon aur parking jaisi sakht satahon par beh kar risa engine oil (hydrocarbons), tyres ka zinc aur sarkon ke namak jama kare.

blocks.alt: Oopar barish ka badal; neeche teen khet (farms) aur aik sarak (road). Har jagah se narangi teer behta pani neeche darya ki poori lambai mein le jate hain.
blocks.caption: Non-point source: barish wasee ilaqe se aaloodgi baha laati hai (hamara apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aaloodgi kisi aik pipe se nahi balke kheton aur sarkon ke poore ilaqe se barish ke pani ke saath aati hai, is liye yeh patli lekin phaili hui hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Wajah ke saath point ya non-point source mein taqseem karein: (i) treatment plants se saaf sewage khaleej ya darya mein chhorne wale pipes; (ii) door ki traffic ya bijli gharon ki nitrogen oxides se bani tezabi barish.
blocks.explanation: (i) Point source: ikhraj aik qabil-e-shanakht pipe se hai. (ii) Non-point source: aaloodgi bohat se door ke zaraye se aati aur mausam ke mutabiq barish se wasee ilaqe par phailti hai.

blocks.prompt: Point aur non-point aaloodgi ke zaraye mein do bare farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Point source aik qabil-e-shanakht jagah se aata aur nikas ke qareeb zyada concentration deta; non-point source wasee ilaqe se aata, kam concentrations door tak phailata, aur toofan jaise mausami waqiat par munhasir hai.

items: Point source: aik qabil-e-shanakht nikas; mutamarkiz plume (karkhane ka pipe, risne wala tank).
Non-point source: barish ke baad phaila hua behta pani; kam concentration, wasee ilaqa (khet, sarkein).
